summary: Configured and verified the NFS share. Both nodes retained Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic. Sequential restarts confirmed persistent service, mount, identities, permissions, and data.
actions_performed: Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Exported /srv/nfs/shared from node1 to node2 with persistent server configuration.
Mounted the share persistently at /mnt/shared on node2.
Set the shared directory to dataops:dataops with mode 2770.
Verified bidirectional writes with files owned 4500:4500 and mode 660.
Restarted node2 and node1 sequentially, confirming changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: NFS export on node1 and persistent mount on node2
evidence.summary: The enabled NFS service exports /srv/nfs/shared to node2; node2's fstab entry and active NFSv4 mount persist.
Both nodes report dataops as UID 4500 and GID 4500.

evidence.requirement: Shared directory ownership, mode, and cross-node consistency
evidence.summary: The directory is dataops:dataops with mode 2770. Files created from either node are visible on both nodes with numeric ownership 4500:4500 and mode 660.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Final verification reports Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic on both nodes.
